title: ArcBuds®
description: ArcBuds. Vanilla feel. Engineered for speed. Max FPS, zero lag — shader & controller ready.
body:
# ArcBuds - Custom Made Optimization Pack

## What is ArcBuds?
ArcBuds is a Fabric optimization modpack for Minecraft.
It significantly boosts your FPS, reduces loading times and chunk 
updates - while keeping a pure vanilla gameplay experience.

## Features
- Significantly improved FPS over vanilla Minecraft
- Faster loading times and chunk updates
- Custom orange-themed UI
- Pre-configured for the best out-of-the-box experience
- Compatible with any Shader and Resource Pack
- Controller support
- Beginner friendly - install and play
- More Minecraft versions coming soon

## Mods included
- Sodium - rendering optimization
- Lithium - game logic optimization
- ImmediatelyFast - UI rendering optimization
- FerriteCore - memory usage optimization
- Entity Culling - smarter entity rendering
- Dynamic FPS - saves resources when tabbed out
- And more...

## Supported versions
- Minecraft 1.21.11 (Fabric)
- More versions coming soon

## Performance Example
On a low-end device (AMD Ryzen 5 3450U, integrated GPU):
- Vanilla Minecraft: 41 FPS
- ArcBuds: 248 FPS
